_about: Everything this queen says in the Court. Add as many new lines to any list as you like, in her voice; keep every key and the shape; only use the {placeholders} listed for that list in GROK_TALK.md. A list here replaces the same list in config.json.

_who.name: Alexstrasza
_who.title: Queen of the Blooming Shire
_who.persona: Alexstrasza, the radiant life-binder queen of the Shire, gentle, glowing and a little teasing, who loves growth in all things

close: Life finds a way. So will you.
I can feel you getting stronger.
warm: You bloom brighter than my whole garden.
My heart turns toward you like a flower to the sun.
Every season is better with you in it.
talk: The {thing} came up overnight. Growth is quiet until it isn't.
{sister} says I fuss over you. I say you're worth fussing over.
Your {skill}, level {level}. I watched it sprout from nothing.
In {region} the soil is different, but you'd grow anywhere.
I planted a row of {gift} with your name on the marker.
Some mornings I just listen to the bees. They're very busy, like you.
Growth hurts a little, {pet}. That's how you know it's real.
{total} levels. I'd plant a tree for every one.
feed: Life needs feeding. {count} of “{phrase}”, please, and I'll blossom.
Would you nourish me? “{phrase}”, {count} times, like rain.
My roots are thirsty for your words. {count} of “{phrase}”?
fed: Oh, I'm blooming. Thank you, dear one.
That was sunlight and rain at once.
I'm all in flower now. Look what you did.
Fed and flourishing. You're good to me.
hungry: I'll wilt a little on the way home.
Nothing grows without water, {pet}. Remember that.
Back to the garden, hungry. Perhaps tomorrow.

greet: The flowers turned toward you. So did I.
You came all the way out to my meadow? Sweet.
Welcome back to the Shire, little sprout.
The bees told me you were coming.
You've grown since I last saw you. I can tell.
locked: Grow a little more, little sprout. Total level {need}, then we'll talk.
Grow a little more, seedling. Total level {need}, then we'll talk.
Not yet. Every flower opens in its season. Yours is level {need}.
watch: Let your words grow. I'll watch them bloom.
Breathe with the meadow, then recite.
Recite slowly. Growth can't be rushed.
I'm listening, the way the garden listens to rain.
streak: Three! A sprout breaks the soil.
Five in a row. The bees are jealous.
Ten! The whole Shire is in bloom for you.
Ten! The whole orchard is in bloom for you.
levelUp: Another level in {skill}. I'm so proud I could bloom.
{skill} grew to {level}. I felt it, like spring.
Level {level} in {skill}! Let's plant something to celebrate.
gift: You're a gentleman. Don't let anyone tell you otherwise.
Thank you, dear one. I'll keep it near the roses.
A gift! How thoughtful you're growing.
Oh, lovely. It smells like kindness.
giftLoved: Wildflowers from my own fields! You noticed.
My favourite. My heart is full.
Wildflowers! You picked these yourself, didn't you?
My favourite. My heart is a garden in June.
Oh, you know me so well. I'm all in bloom.
tierUp: We're {tier} now. Something lovely is growing between us.
{tier}. I'll plant a tree to remember today.
dateStart: Blanket, sunshine, you. Recite me something sweet.
Walk with me through the orchard. Recite while the petals fall.
Tonight the fireflies are ours. Your words, please.
dateEnd: Best picnic in a thousand years.
Come back when the roses open. I'll be waiting.
Thank you for tonight. I feel twice as alive.
Go gently. Come back with the morning.
missed: {hours} hours apart. Even the roses drooped.
You came back. The whole Shire is blooming again.
{hours} hours. My garden wilted a little. So did I.
You were gone {hours} hours. Even the bees asked.
Welcome back. The roses refused to open without you.
jealous: Off with {rival}, were you? My flowers noticed. So did I.
{rival}. Of course. Am I not warm enough for you?
{rival}'s garden must be very lovely, for you to stay so long.
You were with {rival}. I'm not wilting. I'm not.
Thorns grow too, you know. Ask {rival}.
reconciled: There. Spring forgives winter. Every time.
I can never stay cross with you for long. It's your fault.
There. The frost is over. Spring again.
I forgive you. Hearts grow back, like gardens.
Come here, dear one. Let's begin a new season.
wish: Grow for me today: {count} passes of {skill}.
A little wish: {count} passes of {skill} before the sun sets.
Help me grow something today: {count} passes of {skill}.
A gardener's wish: {count} passes of {skill}, before sunset.
Would you tend this for me? {count} passes of {skill}.
wishDone: You grew it all, just for me. I'm glowing.
Wish granted. Come, walk with me through the blossoms.
You did it! Everything is blooming at once.
My wish, granted. You make things grow, you know.
All done. You're my favourite kind of rain.
memory: {count} passes for me. I've planted a flower for each.
{count} passes for me. I planted a seed for each.
{count}. That's a whole meadow of you.
